description: Add a new configuration option called `vitePluginsBefore` that allows users to specify Vite plugins that should be loaded before the React plugin. This is necessary for plugins like @tanstack/router-plugin that require specific ordering to function correctly with JSX transformation.
functional_requirements: Add a `vitePluginsBefore` option to the React module configuration that accepts an array of Vite plugins
Ensure plugins specified in `vitePluginsBefore` are loaded before the React plugin in the final Vite configuration
Maintain backward compatibility so existing configurations without `vitePluginsBefore` continue to work unchanged
Update TypeScript definitions to include the new `vitePluginsBefore` option with proper typing
Document the new option in the module's configuration documentation
